name: Doppelganger’s Visage (Sp)
body:
Benefit: After the saboteur has marked a target with her charlatan’s mark, she can spend a full-round action to take on the target’s persona, as if using both disguise self and vocal alteration to look and sound like the marked target. The effects last until the saboteur marks a different target, 24 hours have passed, or she dispels the visage (a free action).
